overview: The checklist editor is where you build and configure a checklist, opened by 'New checklist' on the Checklists page (or by opening an existing checklist). Its heading is 'New checklist' and it edits every setting on one scrolling page, saved together in one operation. A left rail lists six sections you can jump to: 1 General information, 2 Schedule and availability, 3 Access and scope, 4 Questions and order, 5 Notifications, and 6 Preview. Some sections unlock as you fill earlier ones: you must choose departments before you can add questions, and choose roles before you can pick who is notified. At the top are 'Ask AI Assistant', Cancel, 'Save draft' and 'Save and activate'. This screen replaces the old 'Checklist Wizard'.

steps.text: On the Checklists page click 'New checklist' to open the editor.
Step 1 General information: enter the Checklist name and a General email address, and turn on Signature required or Allow department selection if you need them.
Step 2 Schedule and availability: set the Periodicity (for example Weekly), the Execution day, the Available from and to dates, the Time from and to, and Count current period if it should count now.
Step 3 Access and scope: select the Roles that run it, the Departments it applies to, and any Tags.
Step 4 Questions and order: after at least one department is chosen, add questions by department and drag them into the order you want.
Step 5 Notifications (optional): after roles are chosen, enable the roles that should be notified about executions.

Step 6 Preview: review the whole checklist, then 'Save draft' to keep it as a draft or 'Save and activate' to make it live. All sections are saved together in one operation. 'Ask AI Assistant' can prepare a draft for you to review first.

requires: a Checklist editor role (Company administrator, Corporate manager, Checklist administrator or System administrator)
